name: Go Fashion (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Go Fashion Limited (GFIL) is one of the largest women's bottom-wear brands in India. The company is engaged in the development, design, sourcing, marketing, and retailing of a range of women's bottom-wear products under the brand, 'Go Colors'. The company offers one of the widest portfolios of bottom-wear products among women's apparel retailers in terms of colors and styles. As of May 31, 2021, Go Colors sold bottom-wear in over 50 styles in more than 120 colors.[1]
keyPoints:
India’s Leading Women Apparel brand[1][2]
GFIL is the first and largest company to launch a brand exclusively dedicated to women’s bottom-wear category, with a 8% market share in the branded women’s bottom-wear market as of 9MFY25

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
